caveats: macro_f1 is engine-vs-oracle agreement on a hand-labeled quality canary (10 events, 4 scored rules), not field detection fidelity; see docs/detection-quality.md.
per-rule confusion counts are graded per corpus FILE, not per event.

per-rule expected-positives are corpus-composition-dependent (the corpora are fetched at clone time, not version-pinned): on this snapshot's run the volume-shaped rules bruteforce, lateral_movement, bruteforce_sourceless had zero expected-positives in EITHER corpus (reported as untested) -- splunk/attack_data's brute-force/spray volume lives in non-XML exports this lane's extractor documents as unread; eval/attack/fire_check.py proves all 28 MITRE-tagged rules still fire on their real producer fixtures.

parser_coverage_pct is a corpus-shape measurement: the EVTX corpus is Security/Sysmon-centric, so the published value (see README.md) means 'that share of THE RECORDS IN THIS CORPUS parse', not 'that share of all log formats FENGARDE can ingest'; the 17 shipped parsers cover IT/OT formats the corpora do not contain.
twin metrics are harness-measured on a deterministic in-process plc simulator replay (seed 7) with basis=harness-measured; null fields were not measured in that run, not zero.
ci-clone contamination: GitHub clone counts are inflated by authenticated Actions checkouts and are NOT published here as traction evidence.

units.attribution_accuracy: dimensionless [0,1]; share of incident attributions matching the scenario's ground truth
units.chain_fidelity: dimensionless [0,1]; fraction of the scenario's causal chain the correlation layer reproduced in its incident graph
units.evidence_completeness: dimensionless [0,1]; fraction of expected evidence items present in the evidence package
units.false_correlation_rate: dimensionless; false correlations per true incident (1.0 = every positive had one genuine link)
units.fpr: dimensionless [0,1]; false-positive rate on the twin's benign/negative-control replay
units.incident_reconstruction_time_ms: milliseconds; wall time to rebuild an incident from its member alerts
units.macro_f1: dimensionless, [0,1]; unweighted mean of per-rule F1 (engine-vs-oracle agreement on the hand-labeled detection-quality canary, tools/detection_quality_eval.py) -- NOT field detection fidelity
units.mttd_seconds: mean time to detect, seconds, scenario replay
units.mtti_seconds: mean time to investigate, seconds, scenario replay (null when the run did not produce an incident)
units.mttr_seconds: mean time to respond, seconds (null when not exercised by the run)
units.parser_coverage_pct: percent; share of Security+Sysmon records in the EVTX corpus (records_supported / (records_security + records_sysmon)) that a shipped parser can normalize at all -- corpus-shape-limited, see methodology.md
units.per_rule_confusion: absolute event counts (tp/fp/fn/tn) per rule, graded per corpus FILE by replaying supported records through the real WS-2->WS-4 pipeline against an independent oracle
units.severity_calibration_error: dimensionless; |predicted_severity - true_severity| averaged over scored alerts
units.tpr: dimensionless [0,1]; true-positive rate on the twin's intrusion scenario replay
units.untested_rules: rule names with zero expected-positive events (tp+fn == 0) in the latest corpus run -- surfaced, never implied passing
